unresolved_questions.question: When should a received hazard update take effect?
unresolved_questions.reviewer_note: The immediate-update interpretation is reasonable, but I am unsure whether it matches the intended controller design because LRE-Beh4 does not specify input sampling or delivery timing.
unresolved_questions.implication: Immediate updates remain an explicit analysis/design assumption; agreement with the scoped policy and reporting does not confirm the intended controller input timing.

validation: Matching frozen specification SHA-256, packet ID and all three revisions; exactly five unique matching IDs/titles; complete explicit decisions.
scope: Review of the intended atomic-input contract, provider ownership, integration policy and bounded reporting; separate from impact-benchmark adjudication.
